hook_en: He carries your burden every day. 🙏
reflect_en: David blessed the Lord because He daily bears our burden; not once in a while, but every single day. As this weekend begins, take a moment to thank Him for the weight He carried with you this week, and trust Him as the God of your salvation for what comes next.
q_en: What burden has God carried for you this week?
x_en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation.
tiktok: He bears your burden every single day 🙏 Psalm 68:19–20 — thank Him this weekend
yt_title: The Lord Who Daily Bears Our Burden | Psalm 68:19–20 #Shorts
yt_line: Thank Him for carrying you today.
li_open: No leader is meant to carry the weight alone.
li_quote: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation.
li_body: David praised a God who bears our burden daily, not just in crisis. Leaders who hand their own load to God each day, and pray faithfully for the burdens their people carry, lead from gratitude and rest instead of exhaustion.
hook_es: Cada día te colma de beneficios. 🙏
reflect_es: David bendijo al Señor porque cada día nos colma de beneficios; no de vez en cuando, sino cada día. Al comenzar este fin de semana, tómate un momento para darle gracias por todo lo que te dio esta semana y confía en Él como el Dios de tu salud.
q_es: ¿Por qué beneficio de esta semana le das gracias a Dios?
x_es: Bendito el Señor; cada día nos colma de beneficios el Dios de nuestra salud.
key_es: cada día nos colma de beneficios
